ranked.headline: Statistical models recover spatial and trajectory structure from single-cell omics
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell measurements now demand formal models for noise, spatial dependence, and cell-cell proximity.

ranked.headline: Robust biomedical image representations under cohort, source, and modality shifts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address how biomedical image models generalize across cohorts, sources, and modalities using auxiliary constraints.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of microbial traits from omics and metagenomic data
ranked.summary: Inference is extending to community-level interpretation, yet a metatranscriptomic benchmark found no differential expression method robust to all confounders.

ranked.headline: Reusable genomic resources paired with inference methods across diverse lineages
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple scalable genomic resources with copy-number-aware and structural-variant inference across human, avian, ancient and viral datasets.

ranked.headline: Explicit spatial context in omics analysis recovers tissue organization and niches
ranked.summary: Population-scale spatial proteomics and transcriptomics datasets demand methods that preserve spatial context across tissues and samples.

ranked.headline: Comparative assemblies link transposons, WGD diploidization, and lineage evolution
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and phased assemblies now enable cross-lineage tests of repeat expansion, structural variation, and post-polyploid genome fate.

ranked.headline: Interface descriptors probe protein complexes and AlphaFold prediction reliability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply interface descriptors to AlphaFold3 and OpenFold3 models, testing prediction reliability and interaction screening.

ranked.headline: Deep models trained on sequences, spectra and enrichment data infer molecular function
ranked.summary: Language-model and generative architectures now extract function, structure and selection information directly from raw sequence and spectral data.

ranked.headline: Simulation and sampling constrain RNA and protein conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair atomistic and coarse-grained models with smFRET, CASP16 diagnostics, and high-pressure MD to test structural fragility.

ranked.headline: Generative models increasingly encode synthetic feasibility directly into molecule design
ranked.summary: Recent work couples reaction-aware or synthesizability-rewarded generators with QSAR guidance and benchmarks LLM creativity in molecule generation.

ranked.headline: Machine learning predicts immune recognition: MHC-I binding, TCR specificity, epitopes
ranked.summary: Models now combine language-model embeddings, 3D structure and continual learning to track evolving epitope and TCR binding data.

ranked.headline: Multimodal encoders and attention models advance drug-target and property prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained multimodal encoders and cross-attention now target drug synergy, binding affinity, repositioning, and property prediction.

ranked.headline: LLM agents automate reproduction, model building, and multi-stage analysis in biology
ranked.summary: Three preprints report LLM agents reproducing perturbation baselines, building biomedical ML pipelines, and being benchmarked on genomics tasks.

ranked.headline: Adding rare variants, annotations and environment to genomic prediction models
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous data layers and empirical reproducibility testing are now being used to make polygenic scores more transferable and reliable.

ranked.headline: Spatial arrangement shapes immune activation and interferon readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model link spatial arrangement and dissemination to immune activation and interferon responses.

ranked.headline: Automated single-cell pipelines extend across integration, demultiplexing and proteomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers benchmark and automate single-cell integration, demultiplexing and proteomics analysis stages.

ranked.headline: Representation choice bounds predictive performance in molecular property modelling
ranked.summary: A 143-molecule multitask PAMPA benchmark finds physicochemical descriptors outperform deep representations in QSPR prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and long-read atlases refine transcript and protein quantification
ranked.summary: Single-cell and long-read transcriptomic datasets now permit explicit baseline comparisons and isoform-level resolution of protein and RNA features.

ranked.headline: Graph and phased references recover structural variation missed by linear genomes
ranked.summary: Pangenome, graph, and consensus frameworks now address structural variant calling and CNV interpretation beyond single-reference methods.

ranked.headline: Computational models link non-genetic B cell states to antibody affinity maturation
ranked.summary: Lineage-resolved simulators and biologically informed language models now target antibody affinity maturation trajectories and inference benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Modeling and sampling choices set what structural data can support
ranked.summary: Full-length models, ensemble sampling, and interface metrics now determine how far membrane protein structural data can be interpreted.

ranked.headline: Integrative omics models nominate cancer targets, combinations, and drug candidates
ranked.summary: Public CPTAC proteomics and LINCS L1000 signatures are being reused to nominate cancer therapies and build patient-calibrated mechanistic models.

ranked.headline: Generalist segmentation models benchmarked on live microscopy and spatial-omics data
ranked.summary: Reference-free and cross-modality evaluations of generalist segmentation models now test whether transfer holds for spatial omics and live imaging.

ranked.headline: Physics-constrained methods refine molecular energy models and binding predictions
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and constrained learned models show physical constraints and experimental data are being used to correct energy predictions.

ranked.headline: Learned models fuse heterogeneous cancer readouts to predict clinical and biological…
ranked.summary: Multimodal fusion of CT imaging with transcriptome-derived metabolic models improves ovarian cancer survival estimation in a 2026 study.

ranked.headline: Constraints and latent spaces recover feasible, dynamical metabolic network models
ranked.summary: Recent studies recover thermodynamically feasible fluxes and kinetic models from constraints or learned latent spaces rather than full mechanistic…

ranked.headline: Benchmarked software tools for pangenome, recombination, and transcriptome analysis
ranked.summary: Recent reports release benchmarked pipelines for pangenome graphs, bacterial recombination detection, and RNA-seq assembly and alignment bias.

ranked.headline: Atomistic simulations map conformational landscapes of BRAF, LPA1, and SARS-CoV-2 spike
ranked.summary: State-resolved ensembles from MD and enhanced sampling now link receptor and viral protein dynamics to energetic and functional states.

ranked.headline: Containers and curated workflows target reproducibility in computational biology
ranked.summary: Recent work formalizes containerized workflow execution and kinetic model curation to make computational biology results reproducible and shareable.

ranked.headline: Longitudinal and split-aware benchmarks test automated biological annotation models
ranked.summary: Reference standards for protein function and gene models are evolving, so annotation predictors need continuous, distribution-aware evaluation.

ranked.headline: Regulatory DNA function is being modeled and designed with explicit genomic context
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a yeast study treat genomic position and cell identity as explicit inputs to regulatory DNA design, evolution, and inference.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic and spatial models infer coordinated cell behavior from omics data
ranked.summary: Spatial transcriptomics and bulk or single-nucleus omics are now coupled to reaction-diffusion, causal, and biophysical models to probe disease mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Evaluating how software and FDR choices shape proteomics identification outcomes
ranked.summary: Reproducibility and error-control criteria are being applied to computational proteomics workflows, exposing how software choice alters results.

ranked.headline: Explicit force and order parameters test tissue-scale outcomes in morphogenesis models
ranked.summary: Parameterized models now isolate mechanical and informational terms and test them against tissue-scale behavior in dynamic embryos and epithelia.

ranked.headline: Recurrent architectures approximate complex dynamics in neural and molecular substrates
ranked.summary: Recent work links modular wiring, linear effective descriptions, and molecular recurrent architectures to principled design of network dynamics.

ranked.headline: MD and QM simulations resolve RNA modification and alkylation chemistry
ranked.summary: Recent MD and QM studies resolve how chemical modifications and SAM-dependent RNA alkylation are governed by conformation and electronics.

ranked.headline: Reproducible automated workflows for flow cytometry, replication timing, and RNA-seq
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package established analysis steps into reproducible, GUI-driven or Snakemake software with defined interfaces.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware generative models design codon, UTR, and RNA sequences
ranked.summary: Structural and energetic representations are now being built into generative design of coding and regulatory sequences.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer tumor-relevant features from single-cell and cfDNA data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks, harmonized atlases, and new toolkits are addressing accuracy and reproducibility of inference from single-cell and cell-free DNA data.
